content:
The divisor is not uniquely determined.  
Since \(9984\) is the largest 4-digit multiple of the divisor \(d\), we need \(d \mid 9984\) and \(d>15\).  
But \(9984=2^8\cdot 3\cdot 13\), so it has many divisors greater than 15, e.g. \(16,24,26,\dots\).  

\boxed{\text{Not uniquely determined}}
